description: This file declares the interface for the RdkGstreamerUtilsWrapper class and its factory, which are used to perform GStreamer-related utility functions, specifically audio track codec channel switching, within the Rialto server component.

classes.name: RdkGstreamerUtilsWrapperFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of RdkGstreamerUtilsWrapper, implementing IRdkGstreamerUtilsWrapperFactory.

classes.name: RdkGstreamerUtilsWrapper
classes.description: Implementation of IRdkGstreamerUtilsWrapper providing GStreamer utility functions, including performAudioTrackCodecChannelSwitch.

methods.name: createRdkGstreamerUtilsWrapper
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IRdkGstreamerUtilsWrapper instance.

methods.name: performAudioTrackCodecChannelSwitch
methods.description: Performs a switch of the audio track codec channel, involving GStreamer elements and attributes, within the Rialto server context.
